_comment: The stub's shape kept -- 'ordinary ink plus something semi-rare' -- with the second ingredient decided.
An ink is a pigment carried in a vehicle, so what it wants is a grit, and gloomgrit is one: a drab
powder scraped off a vent's lining whose whole interest is in what it becomes. This is its second use,
and it takes the grit rather than the phasmium grains it otherwise makes on purpose -- the grains are
meant to have exactly one purpose, which is to stop being grains.
Deretheni is the danger material, which design 7.1.1 asks both mid-tier rungs to carry. It earns its
place twice over here: being jet-black it is also the colourant, which nothing else in the pack is.
Two gloomgrit because refining should cost more than the ink itself, not less.
